origin: Created for Project Crosshair with the built-in imagegen tool on 2026-10-16; a new wallpaper, no drawn UI
licensing: Project-provided generated resource, distributed under project MIT terms where applicable. The separate owner-provided visual reference retains its own provenance and is not relicensed.
transform: Exact 3:4 source resized to 240x320 LANCZOS; Pillow MEDIANCUT16, no dithering; truncate RGB888 to RGB565; dark palette RGB565 channels *3//4
packing: Each row independent: high4bits length minus1 (1..16), low4bits palette index; 321 little-endian u16 row offsets; 32 RGB565 u16 colors (classic16/night16)
scratch_scope: No persistent, row or pixel decode buffer; scalar automatic call state and Shell RenderStats are accounted separately
